_comment: Neon Genesis Evangelion 'Rebuild' film tetralogy, 2026-09-18 session. These four films are a self-contained retelling/continuation continuity, separate from the 1995 TV series and End of Evangelion (neither of which we own -- if either is acquired later it should NOT be spliced into this list; the Rebuild films are a deliberate alternate continuity, not a recap of the series, and mixing them produces a nonsensical order). Chronological order IS release order: the films are numbered 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 3.0+1.0 and each follows directly from the previous. No curatorial judgement involved, hence a single variant. All four confirmed present as real files (LocationType=FileSystem) at build time.
